Thanks, Nick

messages.author: 18dfb1393eda7b0e
messages.subject: Re: Knowing onSessionEnded causes?
parts:
I've concluded that there is no way to know what is causing a browser to close a window, if I'm wrong please correct me.

What I did was to create a notification to the server that a close event (or refresh, anything that causes an unload) was hit. This was done by adding the following javascript (it is loaded from the ui, that is another topic) when my application starts.

window.onbeforeunload = function(e) 
{
  Shiny.onInputChange("signalClosing", 1);
  return null;
};

This causes input$signalClosing to be set to 1 and I can react to that in an observer function. I still can not tell what caused the event, but this does give me that ability to react before the session closes (that is, the client and server still communicate). The onSessionEnded function is called after the session is closed. I was able to come up some logic specific to my application that uses this signal.
